description: This file defines a static utility class for managing or checking the usage of the Azure Storage Emulator within tests, specifically to ensure that the emulator is not used in certain test scenarios.

classes.name: StorageEmulatorUtilities
classes.description: A static utility class providing methods to verify the usage of Azure Storage Emulator in testing environments.

methods.name: EnsureEmulatorIsNotUsed
methods.description: Checks the current storage connection string to determine if the Azure Storage Emulator is being used, and throws a SkipException to skip related tests if so.
